canonicalName: St.Gallen Institute of Management in Asia

decisions.reason: Bare institute name is an institutional placeholder, not a department. Official source establishes subsidiary of University of St.Gallen; parent provider is not fabricated as a new discovery record.

sources.note: Entire official institute home read. St.Gallen Institute of Management in Asia (SGI) is the Singapore hub where University of St.Gallen coordinates Asia activities. Explicit bachelor, master and executive teaching; university parent in footer. Current six competence centre names observed on research page; no independent university identity inferred.

Entire Research page read: competence centres Wealth Management, Entrepreneurship, Intercultural Competence, Global Innovation, Business Development and Customer Centricity. No actual Ops/IE centre or degree field verified from this bounded page.

Entire Teaching page read. Explicitly calls SGI a subsidiary of University of St.Gallen, curriculum embedded in parent university, courses at bachelor, master and executive levels. Thesis supervision link is not independent doctoral award evidence.

limitations: SGI is a Singapore subsidiary/institute of University of St.Gallen, not established as an independent awarding university. Parent university requires separate canonical-provider coordination; no guessed duplicateOf ID.
No qualifying Operations, OR or IE unit verified from current institute research inventory. Generic business research centre names do not establish Operations scope.
Parent university doctoral and engineering inventories have not been reviewed in this observation. Institute teaching scope does not prove absence of parent doctoral programmes.
